description: Self-hosted CubeSandbox replica of Tencent AGR Mobile dual control plane (envd :49983 + ADB :5555) on ReDroid Android 16.
description_zh: 在 CubeSandbox 上复刻腾讯云 AGR Mobile 双控制面（envd :49983 + ADB :5555），基于 ReDroid Android 16。

agr_official_reference.base_stack: Cube Hypervisor + SmartRun ReDroid Android 14 x86_64

implementation_notes: Not Tencent official; fork/community replication kit.
CubeSandbox upstream has no published instance_type=android yet.
envd must be GOOS=android; Linux envd from cubesandbox-base will not run.
